data.name: CustomStacks
data.shortDescription: A Quality of Life mod for Inventory tweaking.
data.description:
Mod is based on a Thunderstore mod called: Infinite Inventory.
Edits the maxAmount you can carry for various items in the game.

You do have to edit the CustomStacks.xml manually at this time (sorry about that, still trying to get the settings nailed down,) then refresh the XML with the hotkey or wait up to 5 minutes.
Mod does work, just requires a bit more manual labor.

The xml is in the "...\Sons Of The Forest\UserData" directory.

"StackMod" by Terroducky might be a better option if you don't want to manually adjust the xml.


Special Thanks to:
Toni Macaroni for RedLoader and it's API and Shoko | CEO of Modders for the mod image.

versions.changelog: Re-built the mod from the ground up.
Added console logging,Removed Reactive File Deletion and Restore. (kept crashing sob. A default XML is still created at game boot and this will have to suffice.)
